summary: Russian forces launched a massive overnight combined strike using Kh-101/555 "Banderoil" cruise missiles and Shahed/Geran-5 drones against targets across Ukraine, including Kyiv, Pryluky, and multiple oblasts, while Ukrainian forces struck Russian command posts, river crossings, and logistics in Belgorod, Kherson, and Donetsk regions. Russian MoD claimed capture of Novaya Kazachya in Kharkiv region. Moldova reported three missiles and two drones striking its territory.
key_points: Russian MoD claims control of Novaya Kazachya village in Kharkiv region. (Source: @tass_agency/398652)
Massive Russian cruise missile and drone attack targets Kyiv, Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv regions overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76038, @kpszsu/82572)

Ukrainian strikes hit Russian command post near Novaya Tavolzhanka (Belgorod), river crossing near Novoocheretuvate, repair base near Hromivka (Kherson), ammo depot near Voznesenivka (Belgorod). (Source: @UkraineNow/84457)
Drone strike damages Kyiv's Northern Bridge, blocking traffic, damaging roadway and trolleybus lines. (Source: @UkraineNow/84454)
Moldova reports 3 missiles and 2 drones struck its territory overnight. (Source: @UkraineNow/84459)
Russian air defense claims 244 Ukrainian drones shot down over Russian regions in one day. (Source: @tass_agency/398654)
Russian Foreign Ministry warns foreign diplomats to leave Ukraine, threatens continued massive retaliation strikes. (Source: @tass_agency/398627)
DeepState map shows Russian advances near Kotlyne in Donetsk region. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23879)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces executed a large-scale combined missile-drone barrage overnight October 3-4, launching at least four Kh-101/555 "Banderoil" cruise missiles from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv, Pryluky, Vyshhorod, and Brovary, alongside massed Shahed/Geran-5 drones from six axes including the Black Sea, Bryansk, Chernihiv, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, and Kyiv reservoir. Ukrainian defenses engaged targets across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, and Odesa regions. Simultaneously, Ukrainian precision strikes degraded Russian rear logistics in Belgorod, Kherson, and Donetsk oblasts. Russian MoD announced seizure of Novaya Kazachya in Kharkiv region, while DeepState mapping confirms further gains near Kotlyne.

points: Ukrainian forces conducted precision strikes on Russian rear logistics: command post near Novaya Tavolzhanka (Belgorod region), pontoon crossing over Mokri Yaly river near Novoocheretuvate, repair base near Hromivka (Kherson region), ammunition depot near Voznesenivka (Belgorod region), and drone launch/storage site near Donetsk city. (Source: @UkraineNow/84457)

A Russian drone struck Kyiv's Northern Bridge (formerly Moskovsky), damaging roadway and trolleybus overhead lines, blocking traffic from Left Bank to Right Bank. (Source: @UkraineNow/84454, @ukr_leaks_eng/33694)

Ukrainian Infrastructure Minister Kalashnik announced construction of backup Dnieper crossings (earthen causeways) in Kyiv starting next week, aiming to provide at least half current capacity, with tunnel option under consideration. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33708)

Power outages continue in occupied Crimea: Simferopol, Simferopol district, and southern coast settlements lost electricity overnight October 3, with restrictions across the peninsula. (Source: @UkraineNow/84462)
Russian Ministry of Defense announced capture of Novaya Kazachya village in Kharkiv region by "North" group forces. (Source: @tass_agency/398652, @ukr_leaks_eng/33701)

Russian forces launched massive overnight combined strike: multiple Kh-101/555 "Banderoil" cruise missiles from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv, Pryluky, and Kyiv region districts (Vyshhorod, Brovary), plus Shahed/Geran-5 drones from multiple axes including Black Sea, Bryansk, Chernihiv, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76038, @mon1tor_ua/76040, @mon1tor_ua/76042, @mon1tor_ua/76043, @kpszsu/82572, @kpszsu/82616)
Russian air defense claimed destruction of 244 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions during the day. (Source: @tass_agency/398654)

Russian Foreign Ministry warned foreign citizens and diplomatic personnel to leave Ukraine immediately, stating those who ignore warnings "consciously expose their lives to deadly danger," and vowed continued massive retaliation strikes. (Source: @tass_agency/398627, @tass_agency/398628)
Ukrainian shelling of Belgorod city injured six people including three children, per Belgorod region official Shuvayev. (Source: @tass_agency/398660)
DPR authorities reported one killed and nine wounded from Ukrainian drone attacks and shelling over past day. (Source: @tass_agency/398662)
DeepState map update indicates Russian forces advanced near Kotlyne in Donetsk region, with frontline changes reflected in latest mapping. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23879)
Ukrainian strike targeted Russian drone launch and storage site near Donetsk city. (Source: @UkraineNow/84457)
Russian "North" group captured Novaya Kazachya in Kharkiv region, per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/398652)
Ongoing fighting in Donetsk direction with Ukrainian strikes on Russian drone infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/84457)

Russian cruise missiles ("Banderoil") launched from Chernihiv region flew toward Kyiv, Vyshhorod district, Brovary district, and Pryluky (Chernihiv region). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76038, @mon1tor_ua/76040, @mon1tor_ua/76042, @eRadarrua/119883)

Shahed/Geran drones entered Kyiv region from Chernihiv region along Belarus border toward Slavutych, from Kyiv reservoir toward Vyshhorod, from Cherkasy region via Korsun-Shevchenkivskyi, and from Kirovohrad region toward Bila Tserkva. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76036, @kpszsu/82572, @kpszsu/82617, @eRadarrua/119882)

Multiple air raid alerts in Kyiv: drone threat (yellow level) at 22:26 Oct 3, 00:51 Oct 4, 01:31 Oct 4; all-clear at 23:51 Oct 3, 00:56 Oct 4, 01:36 Oct 4. (Source: @eRadarrua/119852, @eRadarrua/119892, @eRadarrua/119900, @eRadarrua/119906, @eRadarrua/119912)
New groups of jet-powered drones detected from Bryansk region into northern Chernihiv region toward Slavutych. (Source: @kpszsu/82623)

Shahed/Geran drones launched from Black Sea waters targeted Odesa region: at least 6 drones heading toward Tatarbunary, plus drones toward Mykolaiv region (Berezhneguvate, toward Dnipropetrovsk), and toward Zatoka (Odesa region). (Source: @kpszsu/82595, @kpszsu/82597, @kpszsu/82613, @eRadarrua/119895)
Ukrainian strike hit Russian repair base near Hromivka in Kherson region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84457)
Power outages in occupied Crimea: Simferopol, Simferopol district, and southern coast settlements lost electricity overnight Oct 3. (Source: @UkraineNow/84462)
Drone activity from Black Sea toward Mykolaiv-Odesa border region, northwest course. (Source: @kpszsu/82582)

Russian air defense claimed 244 Ukrainian drones destroyed over Russian regions in 24 hours. (Source: @tass_agency/398654)

Critical infrastructure hit: Russian drone struck Kyiv Northern Bridge, severing Left-Right Bank traffic, damaging roadway and trolleybus network; Ukraine accelerating backup Dnieper crossings (earthen causeways) starting next week. (Source: @UkraineNow/84454, @ukr_leaks_eng/33708)

Russian air defense saturation: claimed 244 Ukrainian drones downed over Russian regions in 24 hours; Ukrainian strikes hit Belgorod (6 injured including 3 children), Shebekino (1 child injured by FPV), DPR (1 killed, 9 wounded). sections.threat_assessment: The scale and coordination of Russia's overnight missile-drone barrage — combining strategic cruise missiles with massed Shahed/Geran-5 waves from six launch axes — indicates a deliberate campaign to saturate Ukrainian air defenses and strike critical infrastructure nationwide. Simultaneous Ukrainian deep strikes into Belgorod, Kherson, and Donetsk rear areas demonstrate growing long-range precision capability.
